Aye Paighambar! Khuda se darte rahiye, aur khabardaar kaafiron aur munaafiqon ki itaa'at na kijiyega, yaqeenan Allah har shai ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Aur jo kuch aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se wahi ki jaati hai usi ka ittibaa' karte rahein, ke Allah tum logon ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Aur apne Khuda par e'timaad kijiye ke woh nigraani ke liye bahut kaafi hai

Aur Allah ne kisi mard ke seene mein do dil nahin qaraar diye hain, aur tumhaari woh biwiyaan jin se tum zihaar karte ho unhein tumhaari waaqai maa nahin qaraar diya hai, aur na tumhaari munh-boli aulaad ko aulaad qaraar diya hai. Yeh sab tumhaari zabaani baatein hain, aur Allah to sirf haq ki baat kehta hai aur seedhe raaste ki taraf hidaayat karta hai

In bachchon ko un ke baap ke naam se pukaaro ke yahi Khuda ki nazar mein insaaf se qareeb-tar hai, aur agar un ke baap ko nahin jaante ho to yeh deen mein tumhaare bhai aur dost hain. Aur tumhaare liye us baat mein koi harj nahin hai jo tum se ghalati ho gayi hai, albatta tum us baat ke zaroor zimmedaar ho jo tumhaare dilon ne qasdan anjaam di hai, aur Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Beshak Nabi tamaam momineen se un ke nafs ki ba-nisbat zyaada aula hai, aur un ki biwiyaan un sab ki maayein hain, aur momineen o muhaajireen mein se qaraabat-daar ek doosre se zyaada aulawiyat aur qurbat rakhte hain, magar yeh ke tum apne doston ke saath nek bartaao karna chaaho to koi baat nahin hai. Yeh baat Kitaab-e-Khuda mein likhi hui maujood hai
Aur us waqt ko yaad kijiye jab hum ne tamaam anbiya se aur bil-khusoos aap se, aur Nooh, Ibraheem, Moosa aur Eesa bin Maryam alaihimus-salaam se ahd liya, aur sab se bahut sakht qism ka ahd liya
Taake saadiqeen se un ki sadaaqat-e-tableegh ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaye, aur Khuda ne kaafiron ke liye bada dardnaak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai

Imaan waalo! Us waqt Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo jab kufr ke lashkar tumhaare saamne aa gaye, aur hum ne un ke khilaaf tumhaari madad ke liye tez hawa aur aise lashkar bhej diye jin ko tum ne dekha bhi nahin tha, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal ko khoob dekhne waala hai

Us waqt jab kuffaar tumhaare oopar ki taraf se aur neeche ki simt se aa gaye, aur dehshat se nigaahein kheera karne lagin aur kaleje munh ko aane lage, aur tum Khuda ke baare mein tarah tarah ke khayaalaat mein mubtala ho gaye
Us waqt momineen ka baa-qaa'ida imtehaan liya gaya aur inhein shadeed qism ke jhatke diye gaye
Aur jab munaafiqeen aur jin ke dilon mein maraz tha yeh keh rahe the ke Khuda o Rasool ne hum se sirf dhoka dene waala waada kiya hai

Aur jab un ke ek giroh ne keh diya ke Madina waalo! Ab yahaan thikaana nahin hai, lihaaza waapas bhaag chalo, aur un mein se ek giroh Nabi se ijaazat maang raha tha ke hamaare ghar khaali pade hue hain, haalaanke woh ghar khaali nahin the, balke yeh log sirf bhaagne ka iraada kar rahe the
Haalaanke agar un par chaaron taraf se lashkar daakhil kar diye jaate aur phir un se fitne ka sawaal kiya jaata to fauran haazir ho jaate, aur thodi der se zyaada na thehrte
Aur un logon ne Allah se yaqeeni ahd kiya tha ke hargiz peeth na pheraayenge, aur Allah ke ahd ke baare mein bahar-haal sawaal kiya jaaega
Aap keh dijiye ke agar tum qatl ya maut ke khauf se bhaagna bhi chaaho to faraar kaam aane waala nahin hai, aur duniya mein thoda hi aaraam kar sakoge
Keh dijiye ke agar Khuda buraai ka iraada kar le ya bhalaai hi karna chaahe to tumhein us se kaun bacha sakta hai, aur yeh log us ke ilaawa na koi sarparast paa sakte hain aur na madadgaar
Khuda un logon ko bhi khoob jaanta hai jo jang se rokne waale hain aur apne bhaiyon se yeh kehne waale hain ke hamaari taraf aa jaao, aur yeh khud maidaan-e-jang mein bahut kam aate hain

Yeh tum se jaan churaate hain, aur jab khauf saamne aa jaaega to aap dekhenge ke aap ki taraf is tarah dekhenge ke jaise un ki aankhein yun phir rahi hain jaise maut ki ghashi taari ho, aur jab khauf chala jaaega to aap par tez-tar zabaanon ke saath hamla karenge aur inhein maal-e-ghaneemat ki hirs hogi. Yeh log shuroo hi se imaan nahin laaye hain, lihaaza Khuda ne un ke aamaal ko barbaad kar diya hai, aur Khuda ke liye yeh kaam bada aasaan hai

Yeh log abhi tak is khayaal mein hain ke kuffaar ke lashkar gaye nahin hain, aur agar dobaara lashkar aa jaayein to yeh yahi chaahenge ke aye kaash dehaatiyon ke saath sahraaon mein aabaad ho gaye hote aur wahaan se tumhaari khabrein daryaaft karte rehte, aur agar tumhaare saath rehte bhi to bahut kam hi jihaad karte
Musalmaano! Tum mein se us ke liye Rasool ki zindagi mein behtareen namoona-e-amal hai jo shakhs bhi Allah aur aakhirat se umeedein waabasta kiye hue hai aur Allah ko bahut zyaada yaad karta hai

Aur saahibaan-e-imaan ka yeh aalam hai ke jab unhon ne kufr ke lashkaron ko dekha to pukaar uthe ke yeh wahi baat hai jis ka Khuda aur Rasool ne waada kiya tha, aur Khuda o Rasool ka waada bilkul sachcha hai, aur is hujoom ne un ke imaan aur jazba-e-tasleem mein mazeed izaafa hi kar diya

Momineen mein aise bhi mard-e-maidaan hain jinhon ne Allah se kiye waade ko sach kar dikhaaya hai. Un mein ba'z apna waqt poora kar chuke hain aur ba'z apne waqt ka intezaar kar rahe hain, aur un logon ne apni baat mein koi tabdeeli nahin paida ki hai
Taake Khuda saadiqeen ko un ki sadaaqat ka badla de, aur munaafiqeen ko chaahe to un par azaab naazil kare ya un ki tauba qubool kar le, ke Allah yaqeenan bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur Khuda ne kuffaar ko un ke ghusse samet waapas kar diya ke woh koi faaida haasil na kar sake, aur Allah ne momineen ko jang se bacha liya, aur Allah badi quwwat waala aur saahib-e-izzat hai

Aur us ne kuffaar ki pusht-panaahi karne waale ahl-e-kitaab ko un ke qilon se neeche utaar diya, aur un ke dilon mein aisa ro'b daal diya ke tum un mein se kuch ko qatl kar rahe the aur kuch ko qaidi bana rahe the
Aur phir tumhein un ki zameen, un ke diyaar aur un ke amwaal aur zameenon ka bhi waaris bana diya jin mein tum ne qadam bhi nahin rakha tha, aur beshak Allah har shai par qaadir hai
Paighambar! Aap apni biwiyon se keh dijiye ke agar tum log zindagaani-e-duniya aur us ki zeenat ki talabgaar ho to aao main tumhein mataa'-e-duniya de kar khoobsoorati ke saath rukhsat kar doon
Aur agar Allah aur Rasool aur aakhirat ki talabgaar ho to Khuda ne tum mein se nek kirdaar auraton ke liye bahut bada ajr faraaham kar rakha hai
Aye zanaan-e-Paighambar! Jo bhi tum mein se khuli hui buraai ka irtikaab karegi us ka azaab bhi dohra kar diya jaaega, aur yeh baat Khuda ke liye bahut aasaan hai
Aur jo bhi tum mein se Khuda aur Rasool ki itaa'at kare aur nek aamaal kare use dohra ajr ata karenge, aur hum ne us ke liye behtareen rizq faraaham kiya hai

Aye zanaan-e-Paighambar! Tum agar taqwa ikhtiyaar karo to tumhaara martaba kisi aam aurat jaisa nahin hai, lihaaza kisi aadmi se lagi-lipti baat na karna ke jis ke dil mein beemaari ho use laalach paida ho jaaye, aur hamesha nek baatein kiya karo

Aur apne ghar mein baithi raho aur pehli jaahiliyat jaisa banaao singhaar na karo, aur namaaz qaaim karo aur zakaat ada karo aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaa'at karo. Bas Allah ka iraada yeh hai, aye Ahl-ul-Bait! Ke tum se har buraai ko door rakhe aur is tarah paak o paakeeza rakhe jo paak o paakeeza rakhne ka haq hai
Aur azwaaj-e-Paighambar! Tumhaare gharon mein jin aayaat-e-Ilaahi aur hikmat ki baaton ki tilaawat ki jaati hai unhein yaad rakhna, ke Khuda bada baareek-been aur har shai ki khabar rakhne waala hai

Beshak musalmaan mard aur musalmaan auratein, aur momin mard aur momin auratein, aur itaa'at-guzaar mard aur itaa'at-guzaar auratein, aur sachche mard aur sachchi auratein, aur saabir mard aur saabir auratein, aur farotani karne waale mard aur farotani karne waali auratein, aur sadqa dene waale mard aur sadqa dene waali auratein, roza rakhne waale mard aur roza rakhne waali auratein, aur apni iffat ki hifaazat karne waale mard aur auratein, aur Khuda ka ba-kasrat zikr karne waale mard aur auratein, Allah ne un sab ke liye maghfirat aur azeem ajr muhayya kar rakha hai

Aur kisi momin mard ya aurat ko ikhtiyaar nahin hai ke jab Khuda o Rasool kisi amr ke baare mein faisla kar dein to woh bhi apne amr ke baare mein saahib-e-ikhtiyaar ban jaaye, aur jo bhi Khuda o Rasool ki naafarmaani karega woh badi khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hoga

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab tum us shakhs se, jis par Khuda ne bhi ne'mat naazil ki aur tum ne bhi ehsaan kiya, yeh keh rahe the ke apni zauja ko rok kar rakho aur Allah se daro, aur tum apne dil mein us baat ko chhupaaye hue the jise Khuda zaahir karne waala tha, aur tumhein logon ke ta'non ka khauf tha, haalaanke Khuda zyaada haqdaar hai ke us se dara jaaye. Us ke baad jab Zaid ne apni haajat poori kar li to hum ne us aurat ka aqd tum se kar diya, taake momineen ke liye munh-bole beton ki biwiyon se aqd karne mein koi harj na rahe jab woh log apni zaroorat poori kar chukein, aur Allah ka hukm bahar-haal naafiz ho kar rehta hai
Nabi ke liye Khuda ke faraaiz mein koi harj nahin hai. Yeh guzashta anbiya ke daur se sunnat-e-Ilaahiya chali aa rahi hai, aur Allah ka hukm saheeh andaaze ke mutaabiq muqarrar kiya hua hota hai
Woh log Allah ke paighaam ko pahunchaate hain aur dil mein us ka khauf rakhte hain, aur us ke ilaawa kisi se nahin darte hain, aur Allah hisaab karne ke liye kaafi hai
Muhammad tumhaare mardon mein se kisi ek ke baap nahin hain, lekin woh Allah ke Rasool aur silsila-e-anbiya ke khaatim hain, aur Allah har shai ka khoob jaanne waala hai
Imaan waalo! Allah ka zikr bahut zyaada kiya karo
Aur subah o shaam us ki tasbeeh kiya karo
Wahi woh hai jo tum par rehmat naazil karta hai aur us ke farishte bhi, taake tumhein taareekiyon se nikaal kar noor ki manzil tak le aaye, aur woh saahibaan-e-imaan par bahut zyaada meharbaan hai
Un ki mudaaraat jis din Parwardigar se mulaaqaat karenge salaamati se hogi, aur un ke liye us ne behtareen ajr muhayya kar rakha hai
Aye Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko gawaah, bashaarat dene waala, azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala
Aur Khuda ki taraf us ki ijaazat se daawat dene waala aur raushan chiraagh bana kar bheja hai
Aur momineen ko bashaarat de dijiye ke un ke liye Allah ki taraf se bahut bada fazl o karam hai
Aur khabardaar kuffaar aur munaafiqeen ki itaa'at na kijiyega, aur un ki aziyyat ka khayaal hi chhod dijiye, aur Allah par e'timaad kijiye ke woh nigraani karne ke liye bahut kaafi hai

Imaan waalo! Jab mominaat se nikaah karna aur un ko haath lagaaye baghair talaaq de dena to tumhaare liye koi haq nahin hai ke un se idde ka mutaalaba karo, lihaaza kuch atiyya de kar khoobsoorati ke saath rukhsat kar dena

Aye Paighambar! Hum ne aap ke liye aap ki biwiyon ko jin ka mahr de diya hai, aur kaneezon ko jinhein Khuda ne jang ke baghair ata kar diya hai, aur aap ke chacha ki betiyon ko aur aap ki phuphi ki betiyon ko aur aap ke maamoon ki betiyon ko aur aap ki khaala ki betiyon ko jinhon ne aap ke saath hijrat ki hai, aur us momina aurat ko jo apna nafs Nabi ko bakhsh de agar Nabi us se nikaah karna chaahe, halaal kar diya hai. Lekin yeh sirf aap ke liye hai, baaqi momineen ke liye nahin hai. Humein maaloom hai ke hum ne un logon par un ki biwiyon aur kaneezon ke baare mein kya fareeza qaraar diya hai, taake aap ke liye koi zahmat aur mashaqqat na ho, aur Allah bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

In mein se jis ko aap chaahein alag kar lein aur jis ko chaahein apni panaah mein rakhein, aur jin ko alag kar diya hai un mein se bhi kisi ko chaahein to koi harj nahin hai. Yeh sab is liye hai taake un ki aankhein thandi rahein aur yeh ranjeeda na hon, aur jo kuch aap ne de diya hai us se khush rahein, aur Allah tumhaare dilon ka haal khoob jaanta hai, aur woh har shai ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Us ke baad aap ke liye doosri auratein halaal nahin hain, aur na yeh jaaiz hai ke in biwiyon ko badal lein chaahe doosri auraton ka husn kitna hi achchha kyon na lage, ilaawa un auraton ke jo aap ke haathon ki milkiyat hain, aur Khuda har shai ki nigraani karne waala hai

Aye imaan waalo! Khabardaar Paighambar ke gharon mein us waqt tak daakhil na hona jab tak tumhein khaane ke liye ijaazat na de di jaaye, aur us waqt bhi bartanon par nigaah na rakhna. Haan jab daawat de di jaaye to daakhil ho jaao aur jab kha lo to fauran muntashir ho jaao aur baaton mein na lag jaao, ke yeh baat Paighambar ko takleef pahunchaati hai aur woh tumhaara khayaal karte hain, haalaanke Allah haq ke baare mein kisi baat ki sharm nahin rakhta. Aur jab azwaaj-e-Paighambar se kisi cheez ka sawaal karo to parde ke peechhe se sawaal karo, ke yeh baat tumhaare aur un ke dono ke dilon ke liye zyaada paakeeza hai. Aur tumhein haq nahin hai ke Khuda ke Rasool ko aziyyat do, ya un ke baad kabhi bhi un ki azwaaj se nikaah karo, ke yeh baat Khuda ki nigaah mein bahut badi baat hai
Tum kisi shai ka izhaar karo ya us ki parda-daari karo, Allah bahar-haal har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Aur auraton ke liye koi harj nahin hai agar apne baap daada, apni aulaad, apne bhai, apne bhateeje aur apne bhaanjon ke saamne be-hijaab aayein, ya apni auraton aur apni kaneezon ke saamne aayein, lekin tum sab Allah se darti raho ke Allah har shai par haazir o naazir hai
Beshak Allah aur us ke malaaika Rasool par salawaat bhejte hain, to aye saahibaan-e-imaan! Tum bhi un par salawaat bhejte raho aur salaam karte raho
Yaqeenan jo log Khuda aur us ke Rasool ko sataate hain un par duniya aur aakhirat mein Khuda ki la'nat hai, aur Khuda ne un ke liye ruswa-kun azaab muhayya kar rakha hai
Aur jo log saahibaan-e-imaan mard ya auraton ko baghair kuch kiye dhare aziyyat dete hain unhon ne bade bohtaan aur khule gunaah ka bojh apne sar par utha rakha hai

Aye Paighambar! Aap apni biwiyon, betiyon aur momineen ki auraton se keh dijiye ke apni chaadar ko apne oopar latkaaye raha karein, ke yeh tareeqa un ki shanaakht ya sharaafat se qareeb-tar hai, aur is tarah un ko aziyyat na di jaaegi, aur Khuda bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Phir agar munaafiqeen aur jin ke dilon mein beemaari hai aur Madina mein afwaah phailaane waale apni harkaton se baaz na aaye to hum aap hi ko un par musallat kar denge, aur phir yeh aap ke hamsaaye mein sirf chand hi din reh paayenge
Yeh la'nat ke maare hue honge ke jahaan mil jaayein giraftaar kar liye jaayein aur un ke tukde tukde kar diye jaayein
Yeh Khudaai sunnat un logon ke baare mein reh chuki hai jo guzar chuke hain, aur Khudaai sunnat mein tabdeeli nahin ho sakti hai
Paighambar! Yeh log aap se qiyaamat ke baare mein sawaal karte hain to keh dijiye ke us ka ilm Khuda ke paas hai, aur tum kya jaano shaayad woh qareeb hi ho
Beshak Allah ne kuffaar par la'nat ki hai aur un ke liye Jahannam ka intezaam kiya hai
Woh us mein hamesha hamesha rahenge aur inhein koi sarparast ya madadgaar nahin milega
Jis din un ke chehre Jahannam ki taraf mod diye jaayenge aur yeh kahenge ke aye kaash hum ne Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at ki hoti
Aur kahenge ke hum ne apne sardaaron aur buzurgon ki itaa'at ki to unhon ne raaste se behka diya
Parwardigar! Ab un par dohra azaab naazil kar aur un par bahut badi la'nat kar
Imaan waalo! Khabardaar un ke jaise na ban jaao jinhon ne Moosa alaihis-salaam ko aziyyat di, to Khuda ne inhein un ke qaul se bari saabit kar diya, aur woh Allah ke nazdeek ek ba-wajaahat insaan the
Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur seedhi baat karo
Taake woh tumhaare aamaal ki islaah kar de aur tumhaare gunaahon ko bakhsh de, aur jo bhi Khuda aur us ke Rasool ki itaa'at karega woh azeem kaamyaabi ke darje par faaiz hoga

Beshak hum ne amaanat ko aasmaan, zameen aur pahaad sab ke saamne pesh kiya aur sab ne us ke uthaane se inkaar kiya aur khauf zaahir kiya, bas insaan ne us bojh ko utha liya, ke insaan apne haq mein zaalim aur naadaan hai

Taake Khuda munaafiq mard aur munaafiq aurat aur mushrik mard aur mushrik aurat sab par azaab naazil kare, aur saahib-e-imaan mard aur saahib-e-imaan auraton ki tauba qubool kare, ke Khuda bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
